user.title: Connect to Piazza HQ
user.description: Generate an automation token in Piazza HQ under Settings → Home Assistant Control, then enter it here along with the device's address.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach that host and port. Check the address and that Piazza HQ is running.
error.invalid_auth: That automation token was rejected. Regenerate it in Piazza HQ's Settings if needed.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This Piazza HQ device is already configured.
